answer: Each identity’s roll-call challenge uses a mirror of its own prior traces; a surrounding reef of decoy variants forces a fresh context-specific answer, cross-checked by a three-peer quorum. Copied replies are hollow and fail the variant test. Admission costs a per-identity bond, a per-attempt fee, a rate cap, and ten clean rounds before votes count. A sybil ring fails because shared answers cannot match distinct seeds, and every fake identity must pay the bond and wait out trust.
